summary: Iteration 2: validated the brand rename (BrewSpot -> Café' Reviews), feature removals (Compare, AI chatbot Bean, Date-night mood) and new features (Reviews Dashboard, QR flows, Scan QR page). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass including new /api/reviews/dashboard, /api/reviews (filters + cafe_name), admin avg_rating, and regression tests asserting /api/barista and /api/compare endpoints are gone. Frontend: all data-testids verified end-to-end — brand-logo renders 'Café ' REVIEWS', 5 mood chips (no Date night), Reviews Dashboard KPIs/charts/leaderboard/feed with rating & cafe filters work, cafe-detail-qr-btn opens cafe-qr-dialog with QR canvas + download/copy, admin-qr-cafe-<id> buttons present (10) and open QR, scan page qr-start-camera-btn triggers qr-error in headless (expected), qr-upload-input decodes a generated PNG and navigates to the cafe which auto-opens review-form-dialog; logged-out visit to /cafe/<id>?review=1 redirects to /login?next=... and after login returns to the cafe and auto-opens review form.

minor.issue: avg_rating/aspects use round() but divide by n without guard for empty subsets — fine today but will emit AttributeError if a review doc is missing an aspect key (schema drift). Low risk.
backend/.env CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True in server.py — unchanged from iteration 1. Bearer-token flow still works, cookie refresh would not from a strict browser.

issues: Still says 'Bean is reading every review...' — the Bean chatbot was removed; reword to something brand-neutral like 'Reading every review...' to avoid dangling character reference.
Line 93 of Explore.js: 'Try removing a filter or ask Bean for ideas.' — Bean no longer exists in the app; remove the 'ask Bean' sentence.
qr-error message is clear; no issue — informational only.

action_items: Remove the two remaining 'Bean' references: /app/frontend/src/components/AISummary.js line 19 ('Bean is reading every review...') and /app/frontend/src/pages/Explore.js line 93 ('ask Bean for ideas.').
(carry-over from iter 1) Replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with the explicit public origin to make httpOnly cookie refresh usable.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewsDashboard aggregation (server.py lines 350-370) scans all reviews in-memory for every call — fine at seeded scale but should move to Mongo $group pipelines before growth.
admin_stats calls reviews_dashboard() which fetches up to 10k reviews just to extract avg_rating. Should compute avg via a $group aggregation or keep a running stat.

CafeDetail auto-open-review effect depends on `params` object; using setParams({},{replace:true}) inside the effect that depends on params is fine today (guarded by review===1) but a bit implicit — a one-shot ref would be cleaner.

ScanQR.handle uses `new URL(text)` without checking host; a QR pointing to any site matching /cafe/<id> would route users to this app's cafe page. Low risk because routeFromText still requires the specific /cafe/ path; consider validating URL origin matches window.location.origin.
server.py removed barista/compare — good; file is now 487 lines, still a single-module monolith (same recommendation to split as iter 1).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (all new testids present, flows pass)

seed_data_creation: Review CRUD test creates+deletes a TEST review on first cafe; admin CRUD test creates+deletes TEST_Cafe_*. One stale 'TEST excellent cozy spot...' review on Bloom Garden Bistro from iter 1 is still visible in the dashboard — safe to ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_brewspot_api.py (20 tests, pytest-xdist 2 workers, ~13s). The two Bean leftovers are the only functional miss relative to the change request. Barista & compare endpoints and their frontend routes/components are fully removed. QR encodes <origin>/cafe/<id>?review=1 and the flow auto-opens review-form-dialog in both logged-in direct-visit and logged-out login-then-redirect paths. Generated a test QR PNG at /tmp/test_qr.png to drive qr-upload-input.
rca of the issue: The two 'Bean' strings were left behind because the main agent removed the chatbot component but did not grep for the character name in other files (AISummary loading copy, Explore empty state). Easy fix: textual edits only, no logic change.
